subject.title: feat(macos): UTF-8 clipboard, host clipboard sync, display selection, remote resize, and launch-at-login for Share This Mac

question: Should Share This Mac enable host clipboard sync by default for users upgrading from versions that never shared the host pasteboard?
rationale: This changes a sensitive default across an existing remote-desktop flow, and automation cannot choose the repository's privacy/security policy for upgraded users.

options.title: Default off until explicit opt-in
options.body: Use a false default or migration/first-run consent so upgraded hosts do not start sharing pasteboard contents without a deliberate action.

options.title: Approve default-on clipboard sync
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the privacy tradeoff, but the PR should then document that policy and provide live proof of the opt-out path.

options.title: Gate with a first-run prompt
options.body: Keep the feature discoverable while requiring an in-product consent step before the first host clipboard sync session.

recommendation.title: Default off until explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Use a false default or migration/first-run consent so upgraded hosts do not start sharing pasteboard contents without a deliberate action.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history points to steipete as the owner of the native Mac Share This Mac and clipboard surfaces affected by this policy choice.
